author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: camera body with the reference's raised viewfinder hump and a round lens, on a slim post that splits into three legs 8 below the body. SQUARE candidates were rejected: the legs split within 3 units of the body (internal spacing overlap) and the lens sat exactly 8 from the base (review); VRECT_L gives the height for the post, and raising the lens under the hump gives it 9. The rejected drawing had no hump, a heavy flat body and legs fanning straight from the base.
omissions: The lens is smaller than in the reference (r3, reads as a ring) because the body must keep 8+ units above and below it while leaving room for the post and legs; the tripod legs are shorter than the reference's.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L, mirrored about x=24: body r3 rect x 8..40, y 7..29 with hump (17,7)-(20,4)-(28,4)-(31,7); lens r3 at (24,17) from four quarter arcs; post (24,29)-(24,37); legs to (16,44), (24,44), (32,44).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'camera' (rounded body, raised top, circular lens); straight splayed legs as in 'easel' supports.
